newsitem.title: CANADA: Benson to buy some Mobil Cda assets.
newsitem.headline: Benson to buy some Mobil Cda assets.

text.p: Benson Petroleum Ltd said on Tuesday it signed a deal with with Mobil Oil Canada under which Benson will purchase certain producing oil and gas assets in the Cherhill Area, Alberta.
These assets currently have net production of about 475 BPD of crude oil and liquids and 700 MMCFD of natural gas and are complementary to Benson's current interests in the area.

The purchase includes a 50 percent stake in a gas processing plant, oil battery and water injection facilities. The effective date of the acquisition is January 1, 1997 and is subject to certain conditions.
Some of the assets being purchased are subject to rights of first refusal.
This acquisition will increase Benson's overall production to about 1,475 BPD of crude oil and liquids and 5,700 MMCFD of natural gas at the beginning of 1997.
The addition of these assets is projected to increase Benson's cash flow by over C$2.5 million in 1997, Benson will finance the acquisition initially through the credit facility with its bank.
